title: Constitution Day today; Cabinet clears ₹11,000 crore scheme to make construction equipment in India; India holds 3rd place in Asia Power Index 2026

morning.line: It's Thursday, and it's Constitution Day! Delhi-NCR wakes up to a misty, cool morning with 'poor' air, so wear a mask if you are outdoors for long.
morning.thought: A rule book only works when everyone reads it. Our Constitution gives us rights, and it also asks us to do our part every day.

day.name: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) and National Milk Day
day.about: On 26 November 1949, the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution of India, which came into force on 26 January 1950. Since 2015 the day has been observed as Constitution Day to honour the Constitution and Dr B.R. Ambedkar. 26 November is also National Milk Day, marking the birth anniversary of Dr Verghese Kurien, the 'Father of the White Revolution'.

word.meaning: (noun) an introduction at the start of a document that explains its purpose.
word.example: The Preamble of our Constitution begins with the words 'We, the People of India'.

morning.task: Read the Preamble of the Constitution aloud with your family. Pick any two words from it (such as 'Justice' or 'Fraternity') and write one line on what each means to you.

headlines.title: India celebrates Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) on 26 November 2026.
headlines.summary: India observes Constitution Day on 26 November to mark the day in 1949 when the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution. The theme linked to this year's celebration is 'Hamara Samvidhan, Hamara Swabhiman' (Our Constitution, Our Pride). The government first named 26 November as Constitution Day in 2015, the 125th birth anniversary year of Dr B.R. Ambedkar. Schools and citizens are encouraged to read the Preamble and take part in quizzes and awareness activities.
headlines.gk: The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950, which we celebrate as Republic Day. Dr Rajendra Prasad was President of the Constituent Assembly and Dr B.R. Ambedkar chaired its Drafting Committee. Drafting took 2 years, 11 months and 18 days.

headlines.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹11,000 crore scheme to make construction and infrastructure equipment in India.
headlines.summary: On 25 November 2026, the Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to boost the domestic manufacturing of Construction and Infrastructure Equipment (CIE) and its parts. The scheme will also set up a dedicated testing facility for such machines in India. It will be run by the Ministry of Heavy Industries. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari said the scheme will build local capability, make supply chains secure and create jobs.
headlines.gk: The 'Make in India' initiative was launched on 25 September 2014 to make India a global manufacturing hub. Construction equipment includes machines such as excavators, cranes and road rollers used to build roads, bridges and buildings.

headlines.title: Solomon Islands signs a security treaty with Australia that bars foreign military bases on its land.
headlines.summary: On 25 November 2026, Solomon Islands Prime Minister Matthew Wale and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signed a security treaty at Parliament House in Canberra. Under the deal, Solomon Islands will not allow any foreign military or security base, and Australia becomes its main security partner. Key infrastructure such as ports, airports and telecom must stay free from militarisation and foreign interference. Australia will give A$740 million over 10 years for free education and other programmes.
headlines.gk: Solomon Islands is an island nation in the South Pacific Ocean; its capital is Honiara. The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney.

headlines.title: Bangladesh garment workers win a higher minimum wage after weeks of protests.
headlines.summary: On 25 November 2026, Bangladesh's government-appointed wage board raised the monthly minimum wage for garment workers from 12,500 taka to 17,500 taka. The new pay starts in December, and workers will receive it from January. Workers had demanded 30,000 taka, so not all are fully satisfied. About four million people, many of them women from villages, work in this industry, which earns about four-fifths of the country's exports.
headlines.gk: Bangladesh's capital is Dhaka and its currency is the taka. Bangladesh is the world's second-largest garment exporter after China.

headlines.title: Pakistan's first astronaut reaches orbit and boards China's Tiangong space station.
headlines.summary: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40, became Pakistan's first person in orbit on China's Shenzhou-24 mission, launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in Gansu province. The spacecraft docked with China's Tiangong space station early on 25 November 2026. Ali is the first foreign national to go aboard Tiangong and will stay for about five to 10 days with two Chinese crew members. He trained in China for months and even learned Chinese.
headlines.gk: Tiangong means 'Heavenly Palace'. Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian in space in 1984 aboard the Soviet Soyuz T-11. China aims to land an astronaut on the Moon by 2030.

headlines.title: Gukesh and Sindarov draw Game 2 of the World Chess Championship, keeping the score level at 1-1.
headlines.summary: In Game 2 of the 2026 World Chess Championship in Geneva, India's D. Gukesh played with the white pieces against Javokhir Sindarov of Uzbekistan. The game, played in the London System opening, ended in a draw by repetition after just 20 moves. The 14-game match is now level at 1-1, and the first player to reach 7.5 points wins. Game 3 is on Thursday, 26 November 2026, at 7:30 pm IST, and the prize fund is $2.5 million.
headlines.gk: Gukesh became the youngest undisputed world chess champion in December 2024 by beating Ding Liren in Singapore. Viswanathan Anand was India's first world chess champion.

headlines.title: India keeps 3rd place in the Lowy Institute's Asia Power Index 2026 with its highest score since 2018.
headlines.summary: The Lowy Institute, an Australian think tank, has released the 8th edition of the Asia Power Index. India stays at 3rd place with 40.5 out of 100 points, its best overall score since 2018. The USA is 1st with 78.9 points and China is 2nd with 73.6 points. Timor-Leste is last at 27th with 5.0 points.
headlines.gk: The Asia Power Index started in 2018 and measures 27 countries and territories across Asia using 131 indicators. Economic capability and military capability carry the most weight, 17.5% each.
headlines.exam: Remember: Asia Power Index 2026 (8th edition, Lowy Institute): USA 1st (78.9), China 2nd (73.6), India 3rd (40.5); Timor-Leste last (27th).

headlines.title: RBI Governor meets heads of urban cooperative banks and urges stronger governance and full use of Mission SAKSHAM.
headlines.summary: On 23 November 2026 in Mumbai, the RBI Governor met chairpersons, MDs and CEOs of select urban cooperative banks (UCBs), with representatives of NUCFDC and NAFCUB and all four Deputy Governors present. He noted that UCB credit growth has improved but profitability has lagged, and stressed sound governance, prudent lending, strong cybersecurity, better grievance redressal and full use of Mission SAKSHAM. The same day he met heads of NBFCs and housing finance companies and urged them to use the Central KYC Records Registry (CKYCR).
headlines.gk: The RBI was established on 1 April 1935 and is headquartered in Mumbai; its Governor is Sanjay Malhotra. NUCFDC is the umbrella organisation for urban cooperative banks.
headlines.exam: Remember: Mission SAKSHAM = RBI's training and capacity-building initiative for urban cooperative banks.

headlines.title: Social Justice Ministry unveils the SAMAVESH single-access platform and a revamped e-Anudaan grant portal.
headlines.summary: On 25 November 2026, the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment launched SAMAVESH (Single Access Mechanism for All Verticals of Empowerment & Social Harmony) at Dr Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi. It brings more than 20 departmental portals under one login, with a beneficiary dashboard and an AI chatbot, 'Samajik Sahayak', in over 22 languages through BHASHINI, and links with DigiLocker and PFMS. The revamped e-Anudaan portal handles grant-in-aid under NAPDDR, SMILE, AVYAY and SHRESHTA, with automated document checks and video-based e-inspection.
headlines.gk: The Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment is Dr Virendra Kumar. BHASHINI is India's AI-based language translation platform under MeitY's National Language Translation Mission.
headlines.exam: Remember: SAMAVESH = Single Access Mechanism for All Verticals of Empowerment & Social Harmony; chatbot 'Samajik Sahayak'.

headlines.title: INSA President Shekhar C. Mande is appointed to the UN's 10-member Science, Technology and Innovation group for the SDGs.
headlines.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has appointed Professor Shekhar C. Mande, President of the Indian National Science Academy (INSA), to the UN's 10-Member Group on Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) for the Sustainable Development Goals. His term runs from 2026 to 2028. The group's experts come from civil society, the private sector and the scientific community, and its Co-Chairs for this term are Marian Dorcas Quain of Ghana and Giorgio Rossi of Italy.
headlines.gk: The 10-Member Group was first set up in 2016 under the UN Technology Facilitation Mechanism (TFM), created in 2015. It advises the yearly Multi-stakeholder Forum on STI for SDGs.
headlines.exam: Remember: Shekhar C. Mande (INSA President) – UN 10-Member STI Group for SDGs, 2026-28; group under TFM (2015), formed 2016.

headlines.title: Defence Ministry expands infrastructure for Aero India 2027 after exhibitor demand outstrips space.
headlines.summary: The Ministry of Defence has begun a major infrastructure expansion for Aero India 2027, News On AIR reported on 25 November 2026. The 16th edition will be held at Yelahanka Air Force Station, Bengaluru, from 8 to 12 February 2027. Requests for exhibition space exceeded the initial capacity by about 12,000 square metres, so two new exhibition hangars are being built and exhibitors may add mezzanine floors within their stalls.
headlines.gk: Aero India is a biennial aerospace and defence exhibition, first held in 1996, and is often called Asia's largest air show.
headlines.exam: Remember: Aero India 2027 = 16th edition, 8-12 Feb 2027, Yelahanka AFS, Bengaluru.

headlines.title: LSE, Delhi School of Economics and Institute of Economic Growth sign an MoU at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
headlines.summary: On 24 November 2026, the London School of Economics (LSE), the Delhi School of Economics and the Institute of Economic Growth (IEG) signed an MoU at Rashtrapati Bhavan in the presence of Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan, who is also Chancellor of the University of Delhi. It covers joint research, faculty and student exchanges, doctoral training and knowledge sharing. IEG President N. K. Singh, LSE President Larry Kramer, IEG Chairman Michael Debabrata Patra and DU Vice-Chancellor Yogesh Singh attended.
headlines.gk: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha. The Delhi School of Economics was set up in 1949 and the Institute of Economic Growth in 1958.
headlines.exam: Remember: LSE-DSE-IEG MoU at Rashtrapati Bhavan, 24 Nov 2026, in presence of VP C. P. Radhakrishnan; IEG President N. K. Singh.

quiz.explain: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949, now marked as Constitution Day. It came into force on 26 January 1950.

quiz.explain: Honiara is the capital of Solomon Islands. Port Moresby is Papua New Guinea's capital, Suva is Fiji's and Apia is Samoa's.

quiz.q: Bangladesh's new minimum monthly wage for garment workers is how much?
quiz.explain: The wage board raised the minimum wage from 12,500 taka to 17,500 taka. Workers had demanded 30,000 taka.

quiz.q: Pakistan's first astronaut, Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, travelled to which space station?
quiz.explain: He flew on China's Shenzhou-24 mission to the Tiangong space station and is the first foreign national to board it.

quiz.q: In which city is the 2026 World Chess Championship between D. Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov being held?
quiz.explain: The 14-game match is being played in Geneva, Switzerland. Gukesh won his 2024 title in Singapore.

quiz.q: What was India's rank in the Asia Power Index 2026 released by the Lowy Institute?
quiz.explain: India kept 3rd place with 40.5 points, behind the USA (78.9) and China (73.6).

quiz.explain: Mission SAKSHAM is RBI's training and capacity-building initiative for the urban cooperative banking sector.

Ministry of Women and Child Development

quiz.q: Which Indian scientist has been appointed to the UN's 10-Member Group on Science, Technology and Innovation for SDGs for 2026-2028?
quiz.explain: UN Secretary-General António Guterres appointed INSA President Shekhar C. Mande to the group for 2026-2028.

quiz.q: Aero India 2027, the 16th edition, will be held at which venue?
quiz.explain: Aero India 2027 will be held at Yelahanka Air Force Station, Bengaluru, from 8 to 12 February 2027.

quiz.q: The MoU signed by LSE, the Delhi School of Economics and the Institute of Economic Growth on 24 November 2026 was signed in whose presence?
quiz.explain: The MoU was signed at Rashtrapati Bhavan in the presence of Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan, Chancellor of the University of Delhi.

ai.title: Tamil Nadu begins training 2,000 school teachers to use AI in classrooms.
ai.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has started training 2,000 government and aided school teachers in Artificial Intelligence and ICT teaching methods through SCERT, beginning with a five-day residential programme in Chennai. Over three months, teachers will do 40 hours of online lessons plus lab sessions on adaptive learning, AI-assisted content creation and digital ethics. Officials say about 3 lakh students could benefit each year, with pilot classroom use from January.
ai.gk: SCERT stands for State Council of Educational Research and Training. It works at state level the way NCERT works at national level.

quiz.q: Which state body is running Tamil Nadu's new AI training for school teachers?
quiz.explain: The training runs through Tamil Nadu's State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT).

ai.title: The UAE announces 'Mira', an AI assistant that tells parents how their child is doing in school.
ai.summary: The UAE Ministry of Education has announced Mira, a government AI assistant for public schools. Parents can ask it about their child's grades, attendance and learning gaps, and it can help them set up meetings with teachers. It uses information schools already collect, such as classroom observations and test results, to spot problems early. It will start in March in more than 530 public schools with about 2.8 lakh students.
ai.gk: The UAE is a federation of seven emirates, and Abu Dhabi is its capital.

quiz.q: What is the name of the UAE's new AI assistant for school parents?
quiz.explain: The UAE Ministry of Education named the assistant Mira. It will be used in more than 530 public schools.

ai.title: MeitY Secretary says Sarvam AI's hosting of Chinese models does not break IndiaAI Mission rules.
ai.summary: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan said the government does not see Sarvam AI's hosting of Chinese AI models as a violation of IndiaAI Mission principles. Bengaluru-based Sarvam was one of the first startups picked under the ₹10,372 crore mission to build an indigenous AI model. Krishnan said building frontier models is separate from selling model access, and that AI companies also need revenue. The government supported Sarvam's 105-billion-parameter model and still backs work towards a trillion-parameter model.
ai.gk: The Union Cabinet approved the IndiaAI Mission in March 2024 with an outlay of about ₹10,372 crore. It is run by MeitY's IndiaAI division.
ai.exam: Remember: IndiaAI Mission outlay ₹10,372 crore; MeitY Secretary S Krishnan; Sarvam AI is based in Bengaluru.

quiz.q: What is the approximate outlay of the IndiaAI Mission?
quiz.explain: Business Standard gives the mission's outlay as ₹10,372 crore.

ai.title: India's Shakti Cloud is ranked 35th in the new TOP500 list of the world's fastest supercomputers.
ai.summary: The 68th TOP500 list ranks India's Shakti Cloud system 35th in the world. China's LineShine stays at No. 1 with 2.198 exaflops. South Korea's HANGANG is the highest new entry at No. 12 with 342.6 petaflops. Only 27 new systems joined this list, the fewest in its history.
ai.gk: The TOP500 list of supercomputers comes out twice a year, in June and November. India's own programme is the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM).
ai.exam: Remember: 68th TOP500 – LineShine (China) No. 1 at 2.198 exaflops; India's Shakti Cloud 35th; HANGANG (South Korea) top newcomer at 12th.

quiz.q: Which Indian system is ranked 35th in the 68th TOP500 supercomputer list?
quiz.explain: India's Shakti Cloud ranked 35th; China's LineShine is No. 1.
